caption: The drawing features a rectangular panel centered on a plain beige background. Within the panel, the background is filled with a pattern resembling light wood grain in various shades of yellow and orange. Over this background, a wavy vine extends horizontally from the left to the right edges of the rectangle. The vine is reddish-brown and supports a series of green, serrated holly leaves and clusters of small red berries arranged intermittently along its length. The holly leaves are depicted with dark green centers and lighter edges, with visible veins. The composition is symmetric, with the leaves and berries evenly distributed, and the colors are limited to shades of green, red, yellow, orange, and brown.
title: Decorative Panel from Rail Car Interior
